clips.title: The story
paras: Dark Iron dwarves have broken the powder run to Loch Modan’s southern excavation site. Huldar stays behind with the remaining barrels while Miran prepares to carry the next load forward with an escort.

Huldar and Miran’s powder run through Loch Modan has turned dangerous. After Saean and his conspirators led an ambush, barrels lay scattered and the road became perilous. The two haulers divide their duties: Huldar guards what remains, while Miran prepares to move ahead with the next load.

Loch Modan’s excavation sites need blasting powder to break stone and uncover titan relics. Miran fears another ambush from the ridges along the path. Before loading his cargo, he seeks a companion to travel with him past any traps the Dark Irons may have prepared.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... Business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.
I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?
Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.
